prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: A fox met humans, two women, it said: "Seat me onto the raft, I'll name the river mouths without looking, cover me with tent covers." Now they went downstream. They saw a river mouth, they asked the fox: "What's the river's name?" The fox under the tent cover ate dried meat and said: "Upper." Then it said: "Middle." Then they asked again, it said: "Lower". The fox, having eaten up [everything], said: "Land". They landed, the fox ran away. Those ones chased it. It climbed onto a tree. They burned it. That one started to say: "Leave [a piece as big as] a mitten behind!"
